confidence_notes: Holistic estimate for a tourist-oriented coastal town. July seasonality and room quality create substantial accommodation uncertainty; imported wine is especially variable. Cocktail and wine estimates use approximate local price relationships of 2.5 and 2 times the price of beer, respectively.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on tourist-oriented south-coast towns such as Weligama and Unawatuna, with Mirissa's beach tourism supporting higher prices than inland Sri Lankan towns.
